P1: Check the workbench for tools and parts.
You need the crimping tool, the connector box and the cable coil.
Click each of the three items to pick them up.
P2: The notebook on the workbench holds important notes.
Open the logbook and read both pages.
Page 1 is the wire order, page 2 lists the port links.
P3: Use the wire order from the logbook at the workbench.
Click two wires to swap them until they match the logbook.
Order: White-Orange, Orange, White-Green, Blue, White-Blue, Green, White-Brown, Brown.
P4: The rack needs a cable from the workbench.
Connect the ports listed on the logbook's second page.
P6: The notice board holds a sketch of the network.
Place the devices to match the sketch: router on top, then switch, then two PCs.
P7: The notice board has a sticky note with settings for PC3.
Set ip, mask and gateway, then ping the gateway.
P8: The code uses digits from three places.
Whiteboard left digit, then 7 from the email, then the whiteboard right digit, then the router NODE ID.
